item.title: Burgas has overtaken Sofia in house price growth. Buy now or wait?
item.description: Housing in Bulgaria got almost 15% more expensive in a year, and Burgas rose fastest of all. Here is what is happening after the switch to the euro, and what it means if you are thinking about a flat by the sea.
